details:
So I'm not saying to make this for everyone. But more people would be willing to pay for VRChat+ if you took the category stuff you added for saving worlds, and avatars and allowed people who have + to be able to make new categories as needed.

This isn't just for the reason of standard avatars. It's because roleplayers will have non-rp and rp avatars. Then there's the people who are systems(people with DID/OSDD/MPD) who use the avatars for neither, but instead as a body for their alters to be able to interact on here too. Which makes it hard if they are either a system of over 50, or multiple alters are using multiple different avatars for bodies.

Roleplayers and Systems tend to have it the hardest because the avatars are more of a need for them.

For the roleplayers it's a need because they need something to portray their character properly.

For systems, it's a need because the alters already don't normally feel comfortable in the normal body. This place gives them a way to be themselves for once out here. So it's a matter of identity even more than for those who aren't alters.

In regard to worlds, it's a matter of four categories just doesn't cut it when you look at the vast amount of available worlds out there.

People want to keep track to find things faster. So it would be nice to have a better amount of selection to put them in.

Standard Example;

Games

Music

Hangout Zones

Sleep Worlds

Comfort

Relaxing

Avatars

Avatar Testing

Roleplay

For a system they may have one called 'Trigger Worlds' to keep track of worlds that forcefully trigger their alters.

I know people who have one category listed 'Trauma Worlds' which are worlds where they had such horrible experiences that it causes them to have a panic attack just being in it.

So being able to make as many categories as we like, even if they all had a limited amount you could save to them each, would be amazing.
title: VRChat+ Unlimited Category Creation For World & Avatar Saving
